paragraphs: Rav Yeiva bar Yosi said in the name of Rav. See [Arakhin 5b](https://www.sefaria.org/Arakhin.5b.3).[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Gemara attributes the ruling to Rabbah bar Yosef in Rav’s name, or to Rav Yeiva bar Yosi in Rav’s name. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1615&lang=en) records the Yeiva attribution.
Hyman cites the attribution alone. The ruling concerns someone who consecrates another person’s animal.
